description: Every day one NSE stock was flagged unusual over a date range, with the same fields as unusual. Use it to see how often a stock does this, and look up what followed with adjusted. Required: symbol. Without from and to it returns the last 90 days. Up to 250 rows per call, oldest first. Coverage: NSE from 2010. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).

from.description: First date, inclusive. Default: 90 days before to. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use meta.next_offset from a truncated result.

symbol.description: Exchange ticker, for example RELIANCE, TCS, M&M. Case does not matter.

to.description: Last date, inclusive. Default: today. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

name: unusual_history
title: One stock's unusual days
